svg.title: A frozen reader and a live reader beside one writer
svg.desc: Both readers open the directory store and see the people it holds at that moment. The writer then commits another person to the write-ahead log. The frozen reader still sees only the people at open; the live reader applies the new commit from the log and sees it too.
